why_agent_cannot: enter an email and click the confirmation link
what_human_must_do: Enter your email and click the confirmation link in your inbox.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Open the official Nudge site Go to nudge.xyz and only use the official Nudge app.
2 Step 2 : Pick a reallocation category Choose where to reallocate, such as stables, re/staking or L1/L2s.
3 Step 3 : Select a reallocation target Choose the target asset in your category, for example one of the assets listed under ETH Liquid Restaking.
4 Step 4 : Hold for at least one week A minimum holding period of one week is required for earning rewards.
5 Step 5 : Claim your reward After one week, claim your reward as Nudge directs.
